articles.title: Alphonso Smith Jr. Cause of Death: The NFL mourns the loss of former Detroit Lions and Wake Forest standout
articles.standfirst: A former NFL standout and Wake Forest legend has died at just 40 years old.
articles.summary: A former NFL standout and Wake Forest legend has died at just 40 years old.
articles.body:
The NFL world is mourning following the death of former cornerback Alphonso Smith Jr ., who passed away at the age of 40 .

Widely regarded as one of the greatest players in Wake Forest history, Smith was selected with the 37th overall pick in the 2009 NFL Draft by the Denver Broncos. However, before appearing in an official game for the franchise, he was traded to the Detroit Lions , where he spent most of his NFL career.

According to TMZ Sports , the former player was found dead on Wednesday at a housing community in Florida . Authorities later confirmed that his cause of death was suicide .

The news sent shockwaves through the football world, especially because just hours before his death, Smith had shared a heartbreaking message on social media describing the emotional battle he had been fighting.

Alphonso Smith Jr.'s heartbreaking farewell message

In his final Facebook post, Smith asked people not to cry for him and spoke openly about the struggles that had been haunting him.

Do not cry for me! I tried everything in my power to fight the demons behind the ones that someone put into ME! I did not want to be that WAY! I know I have disappointed so many folks. This is a DEMON in me! But not only me! It's EVERYONE! I have HURT so many! I needed help & did not get it!

His passing prompted an outpouring of grief from fans and former teammates, who remembered the legacy he left during his college career.

Before reaching the NFL, Smith built a remarkable legacy at Wake Forest, where he recorded 188 total tackles, 23.5 tackles for loss, 21 interceptions , and four defensive touchdowns. His outstanding performances earned him All-American and All-ACC honors in both 2007 and 2008 , cementing his place as one of the greatest defensive players in program history.

We extend our deepest condolences to the family, friends, and loved ones of Alphonso Smith Jr. during this incredibly difficult time.

articles.title: Scary scene in Detroit: Jack Campbell immobilized and taken to hospital after neck injury
articles.summary: The Detroit Lions secured a hard-fought 19-15 victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday, but the final minutes came with a frightening scene that quickly overshadowed the result.
articles.body:
The Detroit Lions secured a hard-fought 19-15 victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday, but the final minutes came with a frightening scene that quickly overshadowed the result.

All-Pro linebacker Jack Campbell was placed on a backboard and carted off the field early in the fourth quarter after suffering an apparent neck injury.

The Lions confirmed that Campbell was being transported to a local hospital for further evaluation, leaving teammates, coaches and fans anxiously awaiting an update on his condition.

The injury occurred after Campbell made his third tackle of the game, bringing down Vikings tight end T.J. Hockenson.

Campbell remained face down on the turf and did not appear to move, prompting medical personnel to rush onto the field.

articles.title: Lions provide positive preliminary signs for Jack Campbell as coach leads team in prayer after scary injury
articles.standfirst: The Lions confirm positive preliminary signs after Campbell was rushed to hospital following a frightening collision with T.J. Hockenson
articles.summary: The Lions confirm positive preliminary signs after Campbell was rushed to hospital following a frightening collision with T.J. Hockenson
articles.body:
Detroit Lions fans received an encouraging update on Jack Campbell after the linebacker was hospitalized following a frightening injury against the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday.

The team confirmed Monday that Campbell remains at a local hospital, where he is resting and recovering. Its statement offered a cautiously positive assessment, saying preliminary indications were positive, but added that no further details would be shared out of respect for the player and his family.

Head coach Dan Campbell reinforced that message during his weekly media availability, asking supporters to continue praying for the injured linebacker.

“On Jack, I know that there was a release we put out. It's positive. So, your prayers are working. Please continue to do that. But it is positive news on Jack,” said Campbell .

“I got to see him last night. It was good. It was positive. You know, I got to see his parents [and] talk to his wife. Everybody is in good spirits.”

The injury happened early in the fourth quarter of Detroit’s 19-15 victory over Minnesota. Campbell was attempting to make a tackle on Vikings tight end T.J. Hockenson when his head appeared to make contact with the opponent's hip. He subsequently fell face down and remained motionless on the Ford Field turf.

Medical personnel rushed to his assistance before securing him to a backboard and transporting him from the stadium by medical cart. He was subsequently taken to hospital for further evaluation, where he remained overnight.

Lions rally around their injured teammate

The frightening incident brought the game to a halt and prompted players from both teams to take a knee around Campbell as medical staff treated him. Several Lions approached the cart before he was taken away, while Ford Field fell silent.

The emotional impact continued in the locker room. Dan Campbell gathered his players and led them in prayer, acknowledging that the team had no additional information about the linebacker's condition.

Footage released by Detroit showed the coach visibly emotional as he encouraged everyone to keep Jack in their thoughts and prayers.

Quarterback Jared Goff subsequently addressed his teammates, urging them to remain united, lean on one another and continue supporting their injured teammate. Defensive star Aidan Hutchinson also helped rally the Lions before play resumed, despite appearing deeply affected by the incident.

Detroit eventually completed its comeback, but the result was secondary for many players. Linebacker Derrick Barnes explained that his immediate concern was Campbell as a person, particularly given that he has a wife and young child.

Campbell , 26, was selected 18th overall by Detroit in the 2023 NFL Draft after playing college football at Iowa. He enjoyed an outstanding 2025 campaign, earning All-Pro recognition after recording more than 150 tackles, five sacks and three forced fumbles.

The Lions subsequently demonstrated their confidence in the linebacker by signing him to a four-year contract extension worth $81 million, keeping him under contract through the 2030 season.

Away from football, Campbell and his wife, Megan , also welcomed their first child, a son named Cooper , in February.

Monday's update offers reason for cautious optimism, although the Lions haven't disclosed a diagnosis, test results or a recovery timeline.

articles.title: Detroit Lions’ Jack Campbell gives encouraging hospital bed update after terrifying injury vs Minnesota Vikings
articles.standfirst: The All-Pro linebacker has broken his silence after days in hospital
articles.summary: The All-Pro linebacker has broken his silence after days in hospital
articles.body:
The Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell has delivered an encouraging update on his condition after suffering a frightening injury against the Minnesota Vikings , revealing that he has regained full movement in his lower body. The 26-year-old was left motionless on the turf at Ford Field on Sunday after attempting to tackle tight end T.J. Hockenson . Medical personnel quickly attended to Campbell before placing him on a backboard and transporting him to hospital, with his wife and baby son by his side.

He remained in hospital overnight as concerns grew about the severity of the injury but after several days of limited information from Detroit , Campbell released his first personal statement on Wednesday, offering reasons for optimism while acknowledging that his recovery remains ongoing. "My family and I want to sincerely thank everyone for the overwhelming amount of love, prayers, and support we've received over the past few days," Campbell wrote. "It means more to us than words can express. I'm incredibly encouraged by the progress I've made in such a short period of time. "I have full movement in my lower body, and I'm continuing to make progress with movement in my upper body. I know there's still work ahead, but I remain very optimistic. I'm taking things one day at a time, staying positive, and focusing on getting better. "My faith in God has never been stronger. I know He has a plan for me, and I trust in that plan. I know there may be challenges ahead, but with my faith, my family, and so many people in my corner, I know we'll get through this."

Campbell praises medical experts after scary collision

Campbell 's injury cast a shadow over what was otherwise an important victory for Detroit , with players from both teams taking a knee as he was taken off the field as Aidan Hutchinson was visibly emotional as his teammates attempted to process the situation. However, the result was understandably secondary to his condition as head coach Dan Campbell (no relation) acknowledged the difficult circumstances after the game, describing the victory as "a little bittersweet." And the linebacker also expressed his gratitude towards the medical personnel who responded to the incident, as well as the staff at Henry Ford Hospital who have supported him and his family throughout the ordeal. "I especially want to thank the athletic trainers and medical personnel who responded and cared for me on the field,” Campbell added. “I know those were difficult moments, and I'm incredibly grateful for the professionalism, compassion, and care you showed me. "The way you handled everything and looked after me when I needed it most is something I'll never forget. From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I also can't say enough about the incredible care I've received from the medical team at Henry Ford Hospital and the Detroit Lions medical staff. "They've been amazing to me and my family throughout this process, and I'm truly grateful for everything they've done. To my teammates, coaches, and everyone in the Lions organization, I want you to know how much I love and appreciate you. This team is a family to me, and the way everyone has been there for me means everything. "I'm proud to be a Detroit Lion and couldn't ask to be surrounded by a better group of people. One thing I've learned about Detroit is that this city is built on toughness, resilience, and grit. "That's exactly how I'm going to approach this challenge. Please continue to keep me and my family in your prayers. We feel the love, and I can't thank everyone enough. God is good. My faith is strong." The Lions eventually secured a 19-15 victory, handing Minnesota its first defeat of the season as Jared Goff connected with Jameson Williams for a seven-yard touchdown with 4:35 remaining, completing a comeback after the Vikings had taken a 15-12 lead.
